name: Adept Benefit (Lantern)
text: In addition to the initiate benefits, when you hold your lantern, its light reveals the invisible and the ethereal. The lantern's aura of light increases to a 30-foot emanation. While you're holding your lantern, Invisible and ethereal creatures within the aura become visible as rippling distortions, though they're still Concealed. This doesn't give you any special ability to affect a creature on the Ethereal Plane, but it ensures you're aware of the creatures' presence.
